_comment: Shared test cases for the package inspector. An identical copy lives in both repos: booth-uploader/test/inspector-cases.json (server, packageInspector.js) and TC-booth-SDK/Tests/BoothPackageInspector/inspector-cases.json (SDK, BoothPackageInspector.cs). Keep them the same so both implementations are held to the same rules. entries: path + content (null content = folder). prefix: put in front of every tar entry name. rawEntries: extra tar entries (type file|symlink). raw: write this text instead of a package. expect.errors: one substring per expected error (exact count). expect.flags: flagged path -> exact list of reasons.
